name: Veszkény (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, dark red at the hoist and white at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Veszkény (a blue shield with a church, a ploughshare and a wavy stripe on green) above the name VESZKÉNY in red.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
